title: ModuleBoundary
description: Describes a logical module boundary for architectural analysis. Modules group files and can represent packages, layers, or other organisational units.

moduleId.description: Stable unique identifier for this module boundary.

modulePath.description: File-system path (relative to the repository root) that defines the module root.

files.description: List of file paths (relative to repository root) that belong to this module.

declaredLayer.description: Numeric layer index when a layered architecture is configured. Lower numbers are lower layers (e.g. 0 = infrastructure, 1 = domain). Null when no layering is declared.

isPackage.description: True if this module boundary corresponds to a discrete distributable package (e.g. an npm package or Maven module).

kind.description: How this boundary was detected. 'package' = from package.json or similar manifest, 'directory' = from folder structure at a given depth, 'facade' = from re-export index files (e.g. index.ts), 'namespace' = from language namespaces, 'manual' = user-supplied.

entryPoints.description: Entry points declared in this module's package.json (bin, main, exports). Only present for package-kind boundaries.

file.description: Source file path (relative to repo root) resolved from the manifest entry.

kind.description: How this entry point was declared.

name.description: Optional entry point name (e.g. the bin command name or exports subpath).

isAppEntry.description: True if this entry point belongs to an app package (CLI, server, extension, web app) rather than a library.

isApp.description: True if this package is an application (has bin, start script, vscode engine, or is a pure frontend build). False for libraries. Only set for package-kind boundaries.

appKind.description: Why this package is classified as an app. Only set when isApp is true.
